split.cross_asset_group: common UTC origin-date blocks, local timestamps retained; economic_entity grouping
split.history_insufficient: exploratory_or_unavailable; do not silently reduce required folds
split.purge: Earlier label interval cannot intersect protected next-partition origin/outcome region; earlier outcome_known_at must be strictly before next boundary.
split.embargo: exact task horizon plus one eligible valuation session before boundary; add actual publication lag; if later training rows ever allowed, embargo post-validation origins at least horizon
split.inner: three chronological splits wholly within fit region, purged at their boundaries; transformations fit inside each inner fit
split.calibration: selected estimator held fixed, sigmoid trained on separate purged chronological calibration block
split.final_test: quarantine all outcomes/access; one frozen candidate submission; any tuning afterwards marks test spent; new final test requires untouched or newly mature data

search_caps.scope_per_campaign: one declared task x horizon x market-kind group; all scopes retained but no all-horizon monthly implication
search_caps.rule: Any extra target head, quantile head, ablation or seed consumes remaining fit capacity or separate campaign; illustrative 92-fit schedule is for one scalar target, not six targets at once. Stop rather than exceed.
search_caps.configuration_bound_meaning: At most24declared learned configuration alternatives, sixinitially. R1linear/logisticbaselines count. Actually evaluated candidates/folds/heads must fit96cap;24isnot24xallfolds permission. All configurations and inner search declared before outer results.

resource_caps_proposed.actual_billable_minimum: whole compatible instance billed;4GiB is process target, not provider instance size
resource_caps_proposed.deployment: selective SageMaker training/eval; approved portable Lambda inference; stored daily forecasts; no endpoint
resource_caps_proposed.money_gate: all-in GBP100; operation70/reserve30 across whole system; actual shared USD200 credits unverified; no uncovered fallback
resource_caps_proposed.candidate_billable_instance: ml.m5.large,2vCPU8GiB; data/cost lane pricing candidate, runtime/dependency proof pending

metrics.paired_comparison: candidate and strongest eligible baseline on identical issued origin set; also report full-set and abstention effects

qualification_proposed.paired_interval: must favour improvement; multiplicity/trial registry and final-test quarantine still required
qualification_proposed.threshold_rationale: provisional complexity/cost hurdle and coverage usability; owner and pilot precision approval required before holdout access
qualification_proposed.per_market_kind: separate evidence, fail or abstain unsupported subgroups
qualification_proposed.shadow: mature task-specific prospective outcomes and uncertainty sufficient for approved precision; no eight-week yearly validation; owner, 2026-11-03: 8 scored weeks beating base rate and current rules, see live_trial

contribution_costs: same flow dates/dividends/fees/slippage assumptions; gross and cost-adjusted separate; financial lane XIRR conventions
promotion: owner binding exact artifact/calibrator/task/evidence/scope/expiry; tuner only creates candidates; automatic revert to the previous approved eligible artefact under probation_and_slip is a return to an approved state, not a promotion (owner, 2026-11-03)
safety_disable: only separately owner-preapproved deterministic rules; no auto promotion or resume; recalibration only within bounded_self_correction bands (model-catalogue.json); automatic revert only under probation_and_slip (owner, 2026-11-03)

live_trial.beat_meaning: proposed, open in SCI-D03: a lower mean primary proper score (SCI-06) than each comparator on the trial's paired origins once they mature; the base rate has a proper score directly, the current rules only through rules_proper_score; whether the SCI-06 effect and uncertainty hurdle also applies is open too

rules_proper_score.why: the rules produce only labelled heuristic strength (SCI-04), and only an independently qualified probability mapping may turn rule outputs into probabilities
rules_proper_score.proposal: R0-RULEMAP: a monotone sigmoid mapping from a rules version's heuristic strength to the task's event probability, fitted only on the purged chronological calibration block before the trial starts, then frozen and versioned; it must pass the SCI-05 calibration checks before it can stand as the rules comparator
rules_proper_score.rules_changes: the proposed and the current rules each get their own frozen mapping fitted on the same pre-trial block
rules_proper_score.no_qualified_mapping: the rules comparison for that task is not scoreable and the trial cannot complete for it until the owner decides; the rules are never given a fabricated probability
rules_proper_score.distribution_targets: rules give no quantiles, so for pinball-scored targets the strongest eligible R0 distribution baseline stands in for the rules

live_trial.unscoreable_week: A week that cannot be scored (a data outage, a holiday week) pauses the 8-week trial count; the trial still needs 8 scored weeks.

scored_week_by_horizon.sessions_1_5_10_20: a week counts when its trial origins were issued, or abstained with a reason code, cleanly; its origins are scored when they mature, and the verdict waits until the 8 counted weeks' origins have matured (up to 20 sessions plus publication lag after the last counted week)
scored_week_by_horizon.months_3_6_12: nothing issued in the trial matures inside 8 weeks, so a scored week is a clean-running week: every scheduled origin issued or abstained with a reason code by its deadline, a valid artefact hash, no safety trigger and no late input backdated
scored_week_by_horizon.not_clean: a week that is neither unscoreable nor clean fails the trial, which restarts from zero
scored_week_by_horizon.no_matured_forecasts_yet: not a reason to pause the count: maturity delays the verdict, not the count

live_trial.long_horizons: 3/6/12 months: the 8 weeks check clean running and calibration on what has matured; walk-forward history carries the accuracy evidence; the owner still approves
live_trial.long_horizon_comparison: 3/6/12 months: beating the base rate and the current rules is evidenced by the walk-forward history (SCI-05), not by trial origins
live_trial.long_horizon_calibration_check: open in SCI-D03: no trial forecast matures for 3/6/12 months, so 'calibrated on what has matured' has no trial outcomes; proposed: the frozen candidate replayed point-in-time on the latest matured walk-forward origins, labelled replay, not prospective evidence
live_trial.rules_changes: indicators, pillars and thresholds take the same 8-week shadow trial, beating the current rules, before the owner approves
live_trial.self_correction_during_trial: candidate runs the same bounded code as live (proposed)

probation_and_slip.probation_reading: 2 bad weeks running, mirroring the slip rule (proposed reading; any 2 of the 4 would be stricter; owner to confirm in SCI-D07)
probation_and_slip.statistical_trigger: the slip rule is the owner's statistical trigger; it reverts rather than pauses and is separate from the deterministic safety triggers (POLICY-003)
probation_and_slip.bad_week: live model scores worse than the previous approved model on that week's matured paired forecasts; exact metric, pairing and minimum count open in SCI-D07
probation_and_slip.comparator: the previous approved model keeps issuing shadow forecasts on the same origins, so the comparison is paired (proposed)
probation_and_slip.first_promotion: proposed, open in SCI-D07: with no previous approved model, the comparator and the revert target are the current rules scored through live_trial.rules_proper_score; a revert withdraws the model's probabilities and the scope shows the rules with their heuristic-strength label; without a qualified rules mapping the scope pauses instead (POLICY-003)
probation_and_slip.action: automatic revert to the previous approved model and owner notification
probation_and_slip.revert_records: PromotionRecord: slipping artefact to rolled_back; previous artefact back to active under its own unexpired owner approval; safety_disable_policy_id names the slip rule (the field is reused for this statistical trigger until a schema revision names a separate revert policy; proposed)
probation_and_slip.previous_not_eligible: pause the scope instead (POLICY-003); never revert to an ineligible, expired or revoked version
probation_and_slip.unscoreable_week_in_run: neither counts towards nor breaks a run (proposed)
probation_and_slip.long_horizons: rarely scoreable within probation; rely on the clean-running and calibration check

rules_versus_models_split.label: experimental
rules_versus_models_split.nature: descriptive attribution of each output to rules and models; not a qualified or scored claim; no probability of its own

F7_contribution_policy.live_only_after: beats the simple contribution_comparators for 8 weeks in replay and shadow on the same matched flows, gross and cost-adjusted shown separately
F7_contribution_policy.label: experimental
F7_contribution_policy.nature: simulation for information; no trade, order or instruction
